 District Sawai Madhopur (Rajasthan).
 ----Respondents
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Lakhan Singh Meena For State : Mr. M. S. Shekhawat, Pp with Mr. Rishi Raj
Singh Rathore, Pp Mr. Onkar Singh Rajpurohit, Pp For Complainant : Mr. Praveen Kumar Jain with
Mr. Avinash Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sameer Jain Judgment 08/05/2025
1.

This petition under Section 528 of BNSS is filed, with a prayer to quash the FIR No. 140/2023 registered at Police Station Chauth ka Barvada District Sawai Madhopur for offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC, on the basis of compromise effectuated between the parties herein, in respect of their inter-se dispute.

entities.text: Police Station Chauth ka Barvada District Sawai Madhopur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for both the parties, in presence of their respective clients, have submitted that the dispute at hand is inter-se private in nature, which has been resolved by the parties amicably.

At the outset, this Court deems it appropriate to place reliance upon the judgment passed by the Hon'ble Apex Court in Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab [(2012) 10 SCC 303] and Ramgopal Vs. sentences.text:
State of Madhya Pradesh reported in [2022 (14) SCC 531], relevant portion of which is reproduced below:
"12. The High Court, therefore, having regard to the nature of the offence and the fact that parties have amicably settled their dispute and the victim has willingly consented to the nullification of criminal proceedings, can quash such proceedings in exercise of its inherent powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C., even if the offences are non- compoundable."
5.

In view of the position of law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in aforementioned case, and considering the personal nature of dispute, which has been amicably settled between parties, this Court deems it just and proper to allow the present misc. petition.

6. Considering the aforementioned, the present criminal miscellaneous petition is allowed and the FIR No. 140/2023 registered at Police Station Chauth ka Barvada District Sawai Madhopur, with all consequential proceedings, are hereby quashed and set aside.
